pills.text: POWER, AUTHORITY, LEGITIMACY AND INFLUENCE
CENTRAL FOCUS
[1] POWER SECURES EFFECTS; AUTHORITY IS POWER ACCEPTED AS
[2] LEGITIMACY EXPLAINS WILLING COMPLIANCE WHILE INFLUENCE WORKS WITHOUT

sequence: CENTRAL FOCUS
Power, Authority, Legitimacy and Influence
[1] Power secures effects; authority is power accepted as rightful.
[2] Legitimacy explains willing compliance while influence works without direct force.
[3] Gauba's formula authority equals power plus legitimacy anchors the topic.

stages.title: WEBER, MARX, GRAMSCI AND CLASSICAL ELITE THEORY

pills.text: WEBER, MARX, GRAMSCI AND CLASSICAL ELITE THEORY
CENTRAL FOCUS

[2] MARX AND ENGELS LOCATE POLITICAL POWER IN CLASS

[3] Gramsci adds hegemony, civil society and relative autonomy.
